title: 大跨度空間桁架提升~Lifting of long-span space trusses
focus: 在地面組裝大跨度鋼屋蓋後，以鋼絞線千斤頂或頂升機構整體提升，並控制吊點反力、同步誤差、塔架穩定與就位轉換~Ground-assembling long-span steel roofs and lifting them whole by strand jacks or push-up, controlling lift-point reactions, synchronisation, tower stability and final transfer
summary: 大跨度屋蓋若在高空逐件安裝，需要大量臨時支撐、高空作業與大型吊車；改在地面組裝後整體提升，能提高品質與安全，但提升狀態下桁架的支承點、受力方向與穩定條件都和使用狀態不同。課程以倫敦希斯洛第五航廈 156 m 單跨屋蓋、新加坡濱海灣金沙空中花園的 1,270 t 提升，以及川口衞發展、1984 年首用於神戶世界紀念館的 Pantadome 頂升構法為錨點，說明吊點與吊耳、鋼絞線與千斤頂、同步控制、塔架穩定、試提升、風速停止準則與就位轉換的檢核邏輯。~Erecting a long-span roof piece by piece at height needs extensive falsework, work at height and large cranes; assembling it at ground level and lifting it whole improves quality and safety, but in the lifting state the truss has different supports, force directions and stability conditions from service. Anchored on the 156 m single-span roof of Heathrow Terminal 5, the 1,270 t lift of the Marina Bay Sands SkyPark and Mamoru Kawaguchi's Pantadome push-up method first used at Kobe's World Memorial Hall in 1984, the course explains the checking logic for lift points and lugs, strands and jacks, synchronised control, tower stability, trial lifts, wind stop criteria and final load transfer.

units.anchor: 地面組裝與整體提升~Ground assembly and integral lift
units.title: 為什麼在地面組裝再整體提升~Why assemble at ground level and lift whole
units.mechanism: 大跨度空間桁架在高空逐件安裝時，每個節點都要臨時支撐、高空焊接與檢驗，品質與安全都難控制；若改在地面或低處組裝成大單元，再以多台千斤頂同步提升，可以在穩定的工作面完成焊接、塗裝甚至部分機電與屋面。希斯洛第五航廈 156 m 單跨屋蓋就因機場雷達限制不能使用高大吊車，而在地面組裝後頂升到位；Pantadome 構法則把屋頂中央部分在低處組裝，再以推升機構把可折疊的結構撐到最終形狀。選擇方法時要同時比較臨時工程、提升設備、工期與風險。~Erecting a long-span space truss piece by piece at height means temporary support, welding and inspection at every node in the air, making quality and safety hard to control; assembling large units at or near ground level and lifting them with several synchronised jacks lets welding, painting and even some services and roofing be done on a stable working surface. The 156 m single-span roof of Heathrow Terminal 5 was assembled on the ground and jacked into place because airport radar ruled out tall cranes; the Pantadome method assembles the central part of a dome low down and pushes the foldable structure up into its final shape. Choosing a method means comparing temporary works, lifting equipment, programme and risk together.
units.model: 公開資料指出第五航廈屋蓋分 6 段、每段約 2,200 t，以 8 座塔架、每座 2 台液壓千斤頂提升。每台平均荷載 2,200×9.81/16 ≈ 1,350 kN；若選用單台容量 5,700 kN 的鋼絞線千斤頂（VSL 公布的上限），利用率約 24%。實際千斤頂型號與容量未公開，此處容量比較為教學假設。~Published accounts give the Terminal 5 roof as 6 sections of about 2,200 t, lifted by 8 towers with 2 hydraulic jacks each. The mean load per jack is 2,200×9.81/16 ≈ 1,350 kN; with strand jacks of 5,700 kN each (the upper unit capacity published by VSL) the utilisation would be about 24%. The actual jack models and capacities are not public, so the capacity comparison is a teaching assumption.
units.verify: 以方案比較表列出高空散裝、分段吊裝與整體提升在臨時支撐量、高空作業工時、設備、工期與風險上的差異；選定整體提升後，確認永久柱或臨時塔架能承受提升反力，基礎與樓板的承載也在提升前完成檢核。~Use a method comparison table to set out the differences between piece-by-piece erection at height, sectional crane lifts and integral lifting in falsework quantity, work-at-height hours, equipment, programme and risk; once integral lifting is chosen, confirm that permanent columns or temporary towers can take the lifting reactions and that foundations and slabs are checked before lifting.
units.failure: 若只因工期而選擇整體提升，卻沒有把提升設備、塔架與基礎納入設計，可能在提升前才發現柱頂或樓板無法承受集中反力，被迫臨時補強；反之在受限場地堅持高空散裝，高空焊接品質不穩，安全風險也大增。~Choosing integral lifting for programme alone without designing lifting equipment, towers and foundations can reveal only just before lifting that column heads or slabs cannot take the concentrated reactions, forcing emergency strengthening; insisting on piece-by-piece erection at height on a constrained site gives inconsistent high-level welds and much greater safety risk.
units.misconception: 整體提升只是把高空安裝換成千斤頂，結構設計不必改變。~Integral lifting just replaces erection at height with jacks; the structural design does not need to change.
units.practice: 整體提升的可行性要在初步設計階段就與結構設計同步評估，提升點位置、提升反力與臨時塔架基礎都應出現在設計圖說中；提升方法變更屬設計變更，須由結構設計者重新核算。~The feasibility of integral lifting should be assessed alongside structural design from preliminary design, with lifting points, reactions and temporary tower foundations shown on the drawings; a change of lifting method is a design change that the structural designer must recheck.

units.anchor: 提升點與受力反轉~Lift points and force reversal
units.title: 提升狀態與使用狀態的受力差異~Lifting state versus service state
units.mechanism: 提升時桁架只由少數吊點支承，吊點位置常與最終支座不同，有時還會內縮形成懸臂，桁架的彎矩分布因此改變。使用狀態中受壓的上弦，在吊點附近可能轉為受拉；原本受拉的下弦或斜桿則可能轉為受壓，而這些桿件原本只依受拉設計，細長比可能不足以抵抗挫屈。所以每一個提升階段都要把結構當成一個新的結構系統來分析，包括動力係數、吊點不同步與風載，而不是只看最終狀態。~During lifting the truss rests on only a few lift points, often located differently from its final supports and sometimes set inward to form cantilevers, so the bending-moment distribution changes. A top chord in compression in service may go into tension near a lift point, while a bottom chord or diagonal designed for tension may go into compression with a slenderness never intended to resist buckling. Every lifting stage must therefore be analysed as a new structural system, including dynamic factors, unsynchronised lift points and wind, rather than checking the final state alone.
units.model: 桁架等效為長 120 m、w = 100 kN/m 的梁。使用狀態兩端簡支，跨中 M = wL²/8 = 180,000 kN·m；提升時吊點各內縮 20 m，吊點處負彎矩 M = −w·20²/2 = −20,000 kN·m，跨中變為 w·80²/8 − 20,000 = 60,000 kN·m。吊點附近上弦由受壓轉為受拉、下弦轉為受壓。尺寸與荷載為教學假設。~Treat the truss as a 120 m beam with w = 100 kN/m. In service, simply supported at its ends, the midspan moment is M = wL²/8 = 180,000 kN·m; during lifting with lift points set 20 m inward, the moment at each lift point is M = −w·20²/2 = −20,000 kN·m and midspan becomes w·80²/8 − 20,000 = 60,000 kN·m. Near the lift points the top chord turns from compression to tension and the bottom chord into compression. Dimensions and load are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以施工階段模型分析每個提升階段（離地、提升中、就位、卸載），列出受力反號或利用率增加的桿件清單，逐一檢查挫屈與連接；考慮單一吊點相對高差、動力係數與提升時風載的組合，必要時加設臨時桿件或改變吊點位置。~Analyse every lifting stage (lift-off, travel, arrival, release) in the construction-stage model, list members whose force changes sign or whose utilisation rises, and check each for buckling and connections; combine a relative level difference at one lift point, a dynamic factor and wind during lifting, adding temporary members or moving lift points if necessary.
units.failure: 只按使用狀態設計桁架，提升時吊點附近原為受拉的細長斜桿受壓挫屈，桁架局部失穩；這類事故往往發生在離地瞬間或吊點高差突然增大時，後果是整個提升單元變形甚至墜落。~A truss designed for service alone can see slender diagonals near lift points, intended for tension, buckle in compression during lifting and destabilise locally; such incidents often occur at lift-off or when a lift-point level difference suddenly grows, deforming or even dropping the whole lifting unit.
units.misconception: 提升時的荷載只有結構自重，比使用狀態小，所以一定安全。~During lifting the only load is self-weight, smaller than in service, so it must be safe.
units.practice: 結構計算書要有獨立的提升階段章節，列出每個階段的支承條件、荷載組合、受力反號桿件與臨時加固；未經設計者核可，不得在現場自行改變吊點位置或增減提升單元的範圍。~The structural calculations need a separate lifting-stage chapter listing support conditions, load combinations, members with reversed force and temporary strengthening for each stage; lift-point positions and the extent of lifting units must not be changed on site without the designer's approval.

units.anchor: 吊耳與提升節點~Lifting lugs and nodes
units.title: 提升節點、吊耳與局部加勁~Lifting nodes, lugs and local stiffening
units.mechanism: 千斤頂的集中力要經由吊耳、銷栓或下錨座傳進桁架節點，再分散到弦桿與腹桿。吊耳的淨斷面、銷孔承壓、焊縫與節點板的局部挫屈都要檢核，並考慮提升時吊索可能偏斜所產生的側向分力。節點附近通常需要加勁板或臨時補強，把集中力擴散到足夠的斷面；提升完成後若要切除吊耳，切除方式與殘留部分的疲勞與防蝕也要事先規劃。~The jack's concentrated force passes through lugs, pins or bottom anchor seats into the truss node and then spreads into chords and web members. The net section of the lug, pin-hole bearing, welds and local buckling of node plates must all be checked, including lateral components from strands that may lean during lifting. Nodes usually need stiffeners or temporary strengthening to spread the concentrated force into enough section; if lugs are to be cut off after lifting, the cutting method and the fatigue and corrosion protection of what remains must be planned in advance.
units.model: 吊點力 F = 1,350 kN，吊耳板厚 t = 60 mm、寬 b = 300 mm、銷孔 d = 120 mm，淨面積 (b − d)·t = 180×60 = 10,800 mm²，平均拉應力 σ = 1,350,000/10,800 ≈ 125 MPa；乘動力係數 1.25 為約 156 MPa，對 S355 鋼仍有餘裕，但孔邊應力集中還需另行檢核。尺寸為教學假設。~With a lift-point force F = 1,350 kN, a lug plate t = 60 mm thick and b = 300 mm wide with a d = 120 mm pin hole has a net area (b − d)·t = 180×60 = 10,800 mm², giving a mean tension σ = 1,350,000/10,800 ≈ 125 MPa; with a dynamic factor of 1.25 it is about 156 MPa, still within S355 capacity, though stress concentration at the hole needs a separate check. Dimensions are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 吊耳與節點以有限元素或手算檢查淨斷面、承壓、撕裂與焊縫，焊縫做全數非破壞檢測；提升前目視與量測吊耳的垂直度與銷栓配合，並在試提升時於吊點附近貼應變計，比較量測應變與計算。~Check lugs and nodes by finite-element or hand calculation for net section, bearing, tear-out and welds, with 100% non-destructive testing of the welds; before lifting inspect and measure lug verticality and pin fit, and install strain gauges near lift points during the trial lift to compare measured strain with calculation.
units.failure: 吊耳焊縫在現場倉促施作且未檢測，提升時焊趾開裂；吊索偏斜產生的側向力未計入，吊耳平面外彎曲而撕裂，整個吊點失效時荷載瞬間轉到相鄰吊點，可能引起連鎖破壞。~Lug welds made hurriedly on site without testing can crack at the weld toe during lifting; ignoring lateral force from leaning strands bends the lug out of plane until it tears, and when a lift point fails its load jumps to neighbouring points and can trigger progressive failure.
units.misconception: 吊耳只是臨時配件，隨便焊上去就可以。~Lifting lugs are only temporary fittings, so they can be welded on any old way.
units.practice: 吊耳與提升節點要有正式設計圖、焊接程序與檢驗紀錄，並在圖上註明提升後是否保留；保留者須補防蝕並評估疲勞，切除者須規定切除方式與表面處理，由結構工程師簽認。~Lugs and lifting nodes need formal design drawings, welding procedures and inspection records, with a note on whether each stays after lifting; retained lugs need corrosion protection and a fatigue assessment, removed ones a specified cutting method and surface treatment, signed off by the structural engineer.

units.anchor: 鋼絞線與夾片錨具~Strands and wedge anchors
units.title: 鋼絞線千斤頂的行程、伸長與夾片~Strand-jack strokes, stretch and wedges
units.mechanism: 鋼絞線千斤頂源自預力技術：千斤頂上下各有一組夾片錨具，活塞伸出時上錨夾緊鋼絞線把重物拉上一個行程，回縮時下錨夾住、上錨放鬆，如此反覆。荷載越大、鋼絞線越長，鋼絞線本身的彈性伸長越大，各千斤頂的荷載不同就會造成高差。夾片每次咬合都會在鋼絞線上留下齒痕，重複使用的鋼絞線要檢查損傷並限制使用次數；下錨在停機時是唯一的保持機構，必須可靠。~The strand jack derives from post-tensioning technology: it has upper and lower wedge anchors, and as the piston extends the upper anchor grips the strands and raises the load one stroke; on retraction the lower anchor holds while the upper one releases, and the cycle repeats. The larger the load and the longer the strands, the more the strands stretch elastically, so unequal jack loads create level differences. Each wedge bite marks the strand, so reused strands must be inspected for damage and limited in number of uses; the lower anchor is the only holding device when the jack stops and must be reliable.
units.model: 每台千斤頂 1,350 kN，以 15.7 mm 鋼絞線（破斷 279 kN）、工作荷載 40% 破斷力計，需 1,350/(0.4×279) ≈ 12.1，取 13 根，每根約 104 kN。鋼絞線長 40 m、面積 150 mm²、E = 195 GPa，伸長 ΔL = 104,000×40,000/(195,000×150) ≈ 142 mm。行程 400 mm 時提升 30 m 需 75 個行程。數值為教學假設。~A jack carrying 1,350 kN with 15.7 mm strands (279 kN breaking) at a working load of 40% of breaking needs 1,350/(0.4×279) ≈ 12.1, so 13 strands of about 104 kN each. Strands 40 m long with 150 mm² area and E = 195 GPa stretch ΔL = 104,000×40,000/(195,000×150) ≈ 142 mm. With a 400 mm stroke, lifting 30 m takes 75 strokes. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 鋼絞線進場核對材質證明與外觀，重複使用者逐根檢查夾片齒痕與斷絲；千斤頂以校正過的壓力感測器確認容量，提升前做空載與加載循環測試，確認上下錨夾持與放鬆動作正常；提升中記錄各台行程計數與伸長。~On delivery check strand certificates and condition, and inspect each reused strand for wedge marks and broken wires; confirm jack capacity with calibrated pressure sensors and run unloaded and loaded cycle tests before lifting to confirm that upper and lower anchors grip and release correctly; during lifting record each jack's stroke count and strand extension.
units.failure: 重複使用多次的鋼絞線在齒痕處斷絲，荷載轉到同一束的其他鋼絞線，若連續斷裂可能使該吊點失效；下錨夾片沾污或磨損時夾持力不足，停機時鋼絞線慢慢滑移，重物在不知情下傾斜。~Strands reused many times break wires at wedge marks, transferring load to the rest of the bundle, and successive breaks can fail the lift point; contaminated or worn lower-anchor wedges lose grip, so strands creep while the jack is stopped and the load tilts unnoticed.
units.misconception: 鋼絞線千斤頂的容量夠大，鋼絞線可以無限次重複使用。~If the strand jack has enough capacity, strands can be reused indefinitely.
units.practice: 提升計畫要規定鋼絞線的安全係數、最大重複使用次數、檢查標準與報廢條件，以及下錨夾片的清潔與更換週期；本課只說明檢核邏輯，實際設備操作須由專業提升承包商的合格人員依核准程序執行。~The lifting plan should set strand safety factor, maximum number of reuses, inspection standard and rejection criteria, and the cleaning and replacement interval of lower-anchor wedges; this course explains checking logic only, and equipment must be operated by qualified personnel of the specialist lifting contractor under an approved procedure.

units.anchor: 多點同步控制~Multi-point synchronous control
units.title: 多點同步提升的控制邏輯~Control logic for multi-point synchronous lifting
units.mechanism: 整體提升通常有數個到上百個吊點，VSL 公布其系統可同步控制多達 120 個吊點。控制方式分為位置控制（各點保持相同高程）與荷載控制（各點保持設定荷載），實務上多以位置控制為主、荷載作為監控與警報。由於桁架有勁度，吊點之間的高差會直接轉成反力的重新分配，所以同步允差必須由結構勁度反推，而不是由設備精度決定。控制系統還要能在任一點異常時自動停止所有千斤頂。~Integral lifts usually have several to over a hundred lift points, and VSL states its system can synchronise up to 120. Control can be by position, keeping all points at the same level, or by load, keeping each point at a set load; in practice position control is primary, with load used for monitoring and alarms. Because the truss has stiffness, any level difference between points becomes a redistribution of reactions, so the synchronisation tolerance must be derived from structural stiffness rather than from equipment precision. The control system must also stop every jack automatically when any one point behaves abnormally.
units.model: 若某吊點處桁架勁度 k = 20 kN/mm，允許反力偏差為平均 1,350 kN 的 10%，即 135 kN，則允許高差 Δ = 135/20 ≈ 6.8 mm；控制系統的同步警戒值宜設在約 5 mm。若勁度為 40 kN/mm，允許高差只剩約 3.4 mm。勁度與允許偏差為教學假設。~If the truss stiffness at a lift point is k = 20 kN/mm and the allowable reaction deviation is 10% of the average 1,350 kN, that is 135 kN, the allowable level difference is Δ = 135/20 ≈ 6.8 mm, so the control alarm should be set at about 5 mm. With a stiffness of 40 kN/mm the allowance drops to about 3.4 mm. Stiffness and allowable deviation are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 提升前以結構模型逐點計算勁度，訂出每點的高差與荷載警戒值與停止值；控制系統做功能測試，包括單點故障、通訊中斷與緊急停止；提升中以獨立的測量（例如全測站或雷射測距）抽查控制系統顯示的高程。~Before lifting compute stiffness point by point in the structural model and set alarm and stop values for level difference and load at each point; function-test the control system for single-point faults, loss of communication and emergency stop; during lifting spot-check the levels shown by the control system with independent survey such as total station or laser ranging.
units.failure: 同步允差只依設備規格設定，未考慮桁架勁度，某些高勁度區段在幾毫米高差下反力就大幅偏移，吊耳或桿件超載；控制系統若只監控荷載而忽略位置，感測器漂移時會把錯誤的荷載當成正常。~Setting synchronisation tolerance from equipment specification alone, ignoring truss stiffness, lets reactions in stiff zones shift heavily for a few millimetres of level difference and overload lugs or members; a system monitoring only load and not position can treat a drifting sensor's wrong reading as normal.
units.misconception: 同步提升的精度越高越好，允差可以任意設得很小而不影響施工。~The more precise synchronous lifting is the better, and the tolerance can be set arbitrarily tight without affecting the work.
units.practice: 提升計畫應附每個吊點的勁度、允許高差、荷載警戒與停止值，並明定由誰判讀與決定繼續；警戒值設得過緊會頻繁停機，設得過鬆則失去保護，兩者都要由結構設計者與提升承包商共同確認。~The lifting plan should attach each lift point's stiffness, allowable level difference and load alarm and stop values, and state who interprets them and decides to continue; thresholds too tight cause constant stoppages and too loose give no protection, so both must be agreed by the structural designer and lifting contractor.

units.anchor: 提升塔架與頂升機構~Lifting towers and push-up mechanism
units.title: 提升塔架穩定與 Pantadome 頂升~Lifting-tower stability and Pantadome push-up
units.mechanism: 鋼絞線提升需要在上方設置千斤頂，常利用永久柱或另立臨時塔架；第五航廈即使用 8 座塔架。塔架承受極大的軸壓，任何垂直度偏差、千斤頂偏心或提升單元的水平力都會在高處產生彎矩，挫屈長度又長，因此穩定性往往比強度更控制。Pantadome 則相反：結構在低處以可轉動的鉸接組成，由下方頂升，提升過程中結構呈機構狀態，只靠頂升點與導向維持穩定，到位後再補上鎖定桿件使其成為穩定的殼體。~Strand lifting needs jacks above the load, usually on permanent columns or temporary towers; Terminal 5 used 8 towers. A tower carries very large axial compression, and any out-of-plumb, jack eccentricity or horizontal force from the lifting unit creates moments at height over a long buckling length, so stability often governs more than strength. The Pantadome works the other way: the structure is assembled low down with rotating hinges and pushed up from below, behaving as a mechanism during lifting and kept stable only by push-up points and guides, then locked by adding members once in position to become a stable shell.
units.model: 每座塔架承受 2 台千斤頂，P = 2×1,350 ≈ 2,700 kN。1% 的垂直度偏差產生水平力 27 kN，作用在 40 m 高處使塔底彎矩約 27×40 ≈ 1,080 kN·m。若要求懸臂塔架的彈性挫屈荷載至少為 3P，P_cr = π²EI/(4L²) ≥ 8,100 kN，需 EI ≥ 8,100×4×40²/π² ≈ 5.25×10⁶ kN·m²。數值為教學假設。~Each tower carries 2 jacks, P = 2×1,350 ≈ 2,700 kN. A 1% out-of-plumb gives a horizontal force of 27 kN, which at 40 m height creates a base moment of about 27×40 ≈ 1,080 kN·m. Requiring the cantilever tower's elastic buckling load to be at least 3P, P_cr = π²EI/(4L²) ≥ 8,100 kN needs EI ≥ 8,100×4×40²/π² ≈ 5.25×10⁶ kN·m². Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 塔架安裝後量測垂直度並記錄，設計中納入此偏差與提升時的水平力；塔架基礎做承載與沉陷檢核，提升中監測塔頂位移；Pantadome 類頂升須另外檢核機構狀態下的導向、側向約束與鎖定順序，鎖定前不得撤除任何頂升支承。~Survey and record tower verticality after erection, including the deviation and lifting horizontal forces in design; check tower foundations for bearing and settlement and monitor tower-top movement during lifting; for Pantadome-type push-up, check guides, lateral restraint and locking sequence in the mechanism state, and remove no push-up support before locking.
units.failure: 臨時塔架基礎設在未壓實的地面，提升中不均勻沉陷使塔架傾斜，偏心急遽增加而挫屈；Pantadome 若在鎖定前移除頂升支承或側向導向不足，機構狀態的結構會側傾，整個屋頂可能失穩。~A temporary tower founded on poorly compacted ground settles unevenly during lifting, tilts and buckles as eccentricity rises sharply; in a Pantadome, removing push-up supports before locking or providing too little lateral guidance lets the mechanism-state structure sway sideways and the whole roof can lose stability.
units.misconception: 臨時塔架只要能承受千斤頂的豎向力就足夠。~A temporary tower is adequate as long as it carries the jacks' vertical force.
units.practice: 臨時塔架應有與永久結構同等級的設計與檢查：計算書、基礎試驗、垂直度紀錄與每日巡檢；頂升構法的鎖定程序須寫明桿件安裝順序與完成判定，鎖定完成前所有支承都是停止點，由結構設計者確認後才能撤除。~Temporary towers need design and inspection to the same standard as permanent structure: calculations, foundation tests, verticality records and daily checks; push-up methods need a locking procedure stating member installation order and completion criteria, with every support a hold point until the structural designer confirms locking is complete.

units.anchor: 試提升與荷載核對~Trial lift and load check
units.title: 試提升、重量核對與變形量測~Trial lift, weight check and deformation survey
units.mechanism: 正式提升前要做試提升：把提升單元抬離臨時支撐數十到數百毫米後停住，觀察一段時間。這一步同時驗證幾件事：實際總重是否與計算相符（地面組裝常附帶臨時設備或多餘材料）、各吊點荷載分配是否符合預測、桁架離地後的撓度與計算是否一致、下錨保持是否可靠。若任何一項偏差超過允許值，必須查明原因後才能繼續，否則問題會在高空才暴露，處理難度與風險都大幅升高。~Before the main lift comes a trial lift: the unit is raised tens to hundreds of millimetres off its temporary supports and held for a period. This step verifies several things at once: whether the actual total weight matches calculation, since ground assembly often carries temporary equipment or surplus material; whether load sharing among lift points matches prediction; whether the truss deflection after lift-off agrees with calculation; and whether the lower anchors hold reliably. If any deviation exceeds its allowance the cause must be found before continuing; otherwise problems surface at height where they are far harder and riskier to deal with.
units.model: 16 台千斤頂讀數合計 22,600 kN，計算重量 2,200 t × 9.81 ≈ 21,580 kN，差 +4.7%。若允許偏差 ±5%，勉強合格，但應查明多出的約 1,020 kN（約 104 t）來源。若某單點讀數比預測高 18%，即使總重合格也要停下檢查同步與支承。數值為教學假設。~Sixteen jack readings total 22,600 kN against a calculated weight of 2,200 t × 9.81 ≈ 21,580 kN, a difference of +4.7%. Within a ±5% allowance this barely passes, but the source of the extra 1,020 kN (about 104 t) should be found. If one point reads 18% above prediction, the lift must stop to check synchronisation and supports even though the total passes. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 試提升前清點並移除臨時物件，記錄計算重量的組成；離地後停留規定時間（例如 30 分鐘以上），記錄各點荷載、桁架撓度與下錨滑移量，與預測比較；結果由提升承包商與結構設計者共同簽認後才進入正式提升。~Before the trial lift, inventory and remove temporary items and record what makes up the calculated weight; after lift-off hold for a set period, for example at least 30 minutes, recording each point's load, truss deflection and lower-anchor slip and comparing with prediction; the main lift proceeds only after the lifting contractor and structural designer jointly sign the results.
units.failure: 省略試提升直接提升，若重量被低估或某支撐未完全脫離，提升中某些吊點會突然超載；在高空才發現下錨滑移或桁架撓度異常，不論繼續或下降都很困難，往往只能在不利狀態下臨時固定。~Skipping the trial lift and going straight up means that an underestimated weight or a support not fully released can suddenly overload certain lift points during travel; discovering anchor slip or abnormal deflection at height makes both continuing and lowering difficult, often leaving only emergency fixing in an unfavourable state.
units.misconception: 計算重量已經很精確，試提升只是形式。~The calculated weight is already precise, so a trial lift is a formality.
units.practice: 試提升要寫入提升計畫並列為停止點，明定停留時間、量測項目、允許偏差與決策人；試提升紀錄是後續正式提升與交接的基準文件，必須保存。~The trial lift belongs in the lifting plan as a hold point, stating hold duration, measurements, allowable deviations and decision-maker; its record is the baseline for the main lift and for handover and must be kept.

units.anchor: 風速監測與停止準則~Wind monitoring and stop criteria
units.title: 提升途中的風、擺動與停止準則~Wind, sway and stop criteria during lifting
units.mechanism: 懸吊在鋼絞線下的提升單元就像一個長擺，週期長、阻尼低，橫向風力會讓它緩慢擺動，並在鋼絞線中產生偏斜與不均勻張力；若單元靠近塔架或已完成的結構，擺動可能造成碰撞。因此提升前要訂定風速上限，提升中監測現場與高處風速，並在塔架上設置導向或側向限位裝置。提升時窗要配合氣象預報，避開午後陣風或鋒面，且在整個提升期間保留可安全停止或下降的方案。~A unit hanging from strands behaves like a long pendulum with a long period and low damping; lateral wind makes it sway slowly, tilting strands and loading them unevenly, and near towers or completed structure the sway can cause collisions. A wind-speed limit must therefore be set before lifting, wind monitored at ground and at height during lifting, and guides or lateral restraints fitted to the towers. The lifting window should follow the weather forecast, avoiding afternoon gusts or fronts, with a plan for a safe stop or lowering kept available throughout.
units.model: 懸吊長度 30 m 的單擺週期 T = 2π√(L/g) = 2π√(30/9.81) ≈ 11 s。風速 12 m/s 時 q = ½ρV² ≈ 88 Pa，迎風邊緣面積 5 m × 156 m = 780 m²、阻力係數 1.5，風力約 103 kN，為吊重 21,580 kN 的 0.48%，30 m 吊長的水平偏移約 0.0048×30 ≈ 0.14 m。風速與幾何為教學假設。~A 30 m suspension length gives a pendulum period T = 2π√(L/g) = 2π√(30/9.81) ≈ 11 s. At 12 m/s wind, q = ½ρV² ≈ 88 Pa; on an edge area of 5 m × 156 m = 780 m² with drag coefficient 1.5 the wind force is about 103 kN, 0.48% of the 21,580 kN load, and the horizontal offset over a 30 m suspension is about 0.0048×30 ≈ 0.14 m. Wind speed and geometry are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在提升計畫中依擺動偏移與導向間隙訂出風速停止值，提升前確認導向裝置的間隙與強度；提升中每隔固定時間記錄地面與高處風速、提升單元水平位移與鋼絞線偏角，超過門檻即停止並固定於導向。~Set the wind stop value in the lifting plan from sway offset and guide clearance, and confirm guide clearance and strength before lifting; during lifting record ground and high-level wind speed, horizontal movement of the unit and strand inclination at fixed intervals, stopping and securing to the guides when thresholds are exceeded.
units.failure: 只看地面風速而忽略高處風速，提升單元升到高處時突遇較強風，擺動撞擊塔架；沒有預先規劃停止或固定方案，遇到天候變化時只能冒險繼續提升。~Watching only ground-level wind and ignoring wind at height can expose the unit to stronger wind as it rises, swinging it into a tower; without a planned stop or securing scheme, a change in weather leaves no choice but to keep lifting at risk.
units.misconception: 提升單元很重，風吹不動它，所以風速不必監測。~The lifting unit is so heavy that wind cannot move it, so wind need not be monitored.
units.practice: 提升計畫要列出風速停止值、監測位置、決策人與緊急固定程序，並規定提升前取得氣象預報；任何超過門檻後的繼續作業，都須由提升指揮、結構設計者與安全負責人共同同意並記錄。~The lifting plan should list the wind stop value, monitoring locations, decision-maker and emergency securing procedure, and require a weather forecast before lifting; continuing after a threshold is exceeded requires joint agreement of the lift commander, structural designer and safety lead, recorded in writing.

units.anchor: 就位連接與體系轉換~Final connection and load transfer
units.title: 就位後的連接、溫度與荷載轉移~Connections, temperature and load transfer at arrival
units.mechanism: 提升單元到位後，要從千斤頂支承轉換到永久支座或與相鄰單元連接，這個體系轉換與前面的卸載同樣關鍵。由於提升完成時的溫度、鋼絞線伸長與吊點高差都會影響實際位置，連接設計必須預留調整量，例如長孔、墊片或可調支座；Arup 指出第五航廈屋蓋的鋼構連接以一般製造允差設計，安裝後再調整。荷載轉移要分級進行，並確認每個永久支座實際接手的反力。~Once a lifting unit arrives, it must be transferred from the jacks to permanent bearings or connected to adjacent units, a system change as critical as unloading. Temperature at arrival, strand stretch and lift-point level differences all affect the actual position, so connection design must provide adjustment such as slotted holes, shims or adjustable bearings; Arup notes that the Terminal 5 roof connections were made to normal fabrication tolerances and adjusted after installation. Load transfer should proceed in stages, confirming the reaction actually taken by each permanent bearing.
units.model: 156 m 長的屋蓋單元若在早晨 10°C 提升到位、午後 25°C 才連接，伸長 ΔL = αLΔT = 12×10⁻⁶×156,000×15 ≈ 28 mm，兩端各約 14 mm，連接必須能吸收。若接頭只有 ±5 mm 調整量，就要改在相近溫度時段連接或改用長孔。溫度條件為教學假設。~If a 156 m roof unit arrives at 10°C in the morning and is connected at 25°C in the afternoon, it grows ΔL = αLΔT = 12×10⁻⁶×156,000×15 ≈ 28 mm, about 14 mm at each end, which the connections must absorb. If joints have only ±5 mm of adjustment, connection must be made at a similar temperature or slotted holes used instead. Temperature conditions are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 到位後量測提升單元的三維位置與當時溫度，與設計位置在參考溫度下比較；連接完成後分級下放千斤頂，每級記錄千斤頂荷載與永久支座反力或沉陷，確認荷載完全轉移且符合預測後，才拆除提升設備。~On arrival survey the unit's three-dimensional position and temperature and compare with the design position at the reference temperature; after connection lower the jacks in stages, recording jack loads and permanent bearing reactions or settlements at each stage, and remove lifting equipment only after confirming full transfer consistent with prediction.
units.failure: 高溫時強行把接頭對準鎖固，降溫後屋蓋收縮，接頭與支座承受很大的拉力或剪力；千斤頂一次全部放鬆，荷載突然轉到永久支座，若某支座還未完全就位或墊片不足，局部構件會過載。~Forcing joints into alignment and locking them in hot weather leaves joints and bearings under large tension or shear when the roof contracts as it cools; releasing all jacks at once dumps load suddenly onto permanent bearings, and if one bearing is not fully seated or under-shimmed, local members are overloaded.
units.misconception: 提升到位就代表工作完成，千斤頂可以直接拆除。~Once the unit reaches position the work is done and the jacks can simply be removed.
units.practice: 連接與荷載轉移程序須寫明連接的溫度時段、可用調整量、下放分級與每級的量測項目；荷載轉移前，結構設計者應確認所有永久連接與支座已依圖完成，這是拆除提升設備前的最後停止點。~The connection and load-transfer procedure should state the temperature window for connection, available adjustment, lowering stages and measurements at each stage; before transfer the structural designer should confirm that every permanent connection and bearing is complete to the drawings, the last hold point before lifting equipment is removed.

units.anchor: 提升紀錄與殘留應力~Lift records and locked-in stresses
units.title: 提升紀錄、殘留應力與交接~Lift records, locked-in stresses and handover
units.mechanism: 整體提升完成後，結構中會留下與施工順序有關的殘留內力：吊點高差、連接時的溫度與支座就位順序，都會讓實際內力偏離只看最終狀態的分析。提升時焊上的吊耳若保留，會成為疲勞與腐蝕的弱點；切除時的熱影響與研磨痕跡也需處理。這些資訊若沒有交接，日後檢測時看到的局部應力或變形，就無法判斷是施工遺留還是使用中的劣化，因此提升紀錄是結構檔案的一部分。~After an integral lift the structure carries locked-in forces tied to the construction sequence: lift-point level differences, connection temperature and the order in which bearings seated all move actual forces away from an analysis of the final state alone. Lugs welded for lifting become fatigue and corrosion weak points if left in place, and the heat-affected zones and grinding marks from cutting them off also need treatment. Without handover of this information, later inspectors cannot tell whether local stress or deformation is left over from construction or deterioration in service, so lifting records belong in the structural file.
units.model: 若連接時某支座比相鄰支座高 10 mm 而強行鎖固，桁架在該處勁度 k = 20 kN/mm，殘留附加反力約 ΔR = k·Δ = 200 kN，約為平均提升反力 1,350 kN 的 15%，並在相鄰桿件留下相應的殘留內力。高差與勁度為教學假設。~If at connection one bearing sits 10 mm higher than its neighbour and is locked anyway, with a truss stiffness k = 20 kN/mm there, a residual additional reaction of about ΔR = k·Δ = 200 kN remains, about 15% of the 1,350 kN mean lifting reaction, with corresponding locked-in forces in adjacent members. Level difference and stiffness are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 整理每次提升的千斤頂荷載、行程、同步紀錄、風速、試提升結果與就位量測，與施工階段分析一併歸檔；完工後量測支座反力或代表性桿件應變作為基準，並檢查保留或切除吊耳處的焊縫與塗裝。~Compile each lift's jack loads, strokes, synchronisation logs, wind records, trial-lift results and arrival surveys and file them with the construction-stage analysis; after completion measure bearing reactions or representative member strains as a baseline and inspect welds and coatings at retained or removed lugs.
units.failure: 保留的吊耳焊趾在風振與溫度循環下產生疲勞裂紋，多年後在檢測時才發現；沒有提升與就位紀錄，管理者面對異常變形時只能做大規模檢測，耗費大量成本，也可能誤判結構安全。~Retained lug weld toes develop fatigue cracks under wind vibration and thermal cycling that are discovered only years later at inspection; without lifting and arrival records, managers facing unusual deformation can only commission extensive surveys at great cost and may misjudge structural safety.
units.misconception: 提升是施工過程，完工後就與結構使用無關。~Lifting is a construction process with no bearing on the structure once it is finished.
units.practice: 交接文件應包含提升計畫與實際紀錄、試提升報告、就位量測、殘留應力評估、吊耳保留或切除位置圖與處理方式；日後任何在原吊點附近的改裝都要參考這些紀錄，並由結構工程師評估。~Handover should include the lifting plan and actual records, the trial-lift report, arrival surveys, an assessment of locked-in stresses and a plan of retained or removed lug locations with their treatment; any later alteration near former lift points must refer to these records and be assessed by the structural engineer.

example: 設計練習：為一個屋蓋提升單元做初步提升設計。假設單元重 2,200 t，以 8 座塔架、每座 2 台千斤頂共 16 點提升，W = 2,200×9.81 ≈ 21,580 kN，平均每點 1,350 kN。（1）鋼絞線：15.7 mm、破斷 279 kN、工作荷載取 40% 破斷，需 1,350/111.6 ≈ 12.1 → 13 根，每根約 104 kN；長 40 m 時伸長約 142 mm。（2）同步：吊點勁度 20 kN/mm、允許反力偏差 10%（135 kN），允許高差約 6.8 mm，警戒設 5 mm。（3）時間：提升 30 m、速度 10 m/h，純提升約 3 h，加試提升停留與就位約半天。（4）若改為 12 點提升，每點 1,800 kN，鋼絞線需 1,800/111.6 ≈ 16.1 → 17 根，伸長約 145 mm，但每座塔架荷載增為 3 台時約 5,400 kN，塔架挫屈需求隨之上升。所有數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際專案的提升設計。~Design exercise: preliminary lifting design for a roof unit. Assume the unit weighs 2,200 t and is lifted at 16 points by 8 towers with 2 jacks each, W = 2,200×9.81 ≈ 21,580 kN, an average of 1,350 kN per point. (1) Strands: 15.7 mm with 279 kN breaking load at a working load of 40% of breaking needs 1,350/111.6 ≈ 12.1, so 13 strands of about 104 kN; 40 m long they stretch about 142 mm. (2) Synchronisation: with 20 kN/mm stiffness at a lift point and a 10% (135 kN) allowable reaction deviation, the allowable level difference is about 6.8 mm, with an alarm at 5 mm. (3) Time: lifting 30 m at 10 m/h takes about 3 h of pure lifting, about half a day with the trial-lift hold and final positioning. (4) With 12 points instead, each carries 1,800 kN and needs 1,800/111.6 ≈ 16.1, so 17 strands stretching about 145 mm, while a tower with 3 jacks carries about 5,400 kN and its buckling demand rises accordingly. All values are teaching assumptions, not the lifting design of any real project.
history: 以千斤頂整體提升大型結構的做法，隨著預力技術發展出的鋼絞線千斤頂與電腦同步控制而成熟，讓數千噸的屋蓋可以在地面組裝後提升數十公尺。日本結構工程師川口衞發展的 Pantadome 構法在 1984 年首次用於神戶世界紀念館，其後用於大阪 Namihaya Dome 等場館；倫敦希斯洛第五航廈 156 m 單跨屋蓋因雷達限制在地面組裝後分段頂升，最後一段於 2005 年就位；2010 年前後的新加坡濱海灣金沙空中花園則把約 1,270 t 的箱梁提升到約 200 m 高空。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件或操作許可。~Lifting large structures whole with jacks matured with strand jacks derived from post-tensioning and with computer synchronisation, allowing roofs of thousands of tonnes to be assembled at ground level and raised tens of metres. Japanese structural engineer Mamoru Kawaguchi's Pantadome method was first used at Kobe's World Memorial Hall in 1984 and later at venues such as Osaka's Namihaya Dome; the 156 m single-span roof of Heathrow Terminal 5 was assembled on the ground and jacked up in sections because of radar restrictions, the last section placed in 2005; and around 2010 the Marina Bay Sands SkyPark in Singapore raised a box-girder pair of about 1,270 t to about 200 m. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents or operating authorisation.
facts: VSL 公布其鋼絞線千斤頂單台容量可達約 5,700 kN，並可同步控制多達 120 個吊點~VSL states its strand jacks reach about 5,700 kN per unit, with up to 120 synchronised lifting points
希斯洛第五航廈主屋蓋為約 156 m 單跨，在地面組裝後頂升到位~Heathrow Terminal 5's main roof is a single span of about 156 m, assembled on the ground and jacked into place
第五航廈屋蓋分 6 段，每段約 2,200 t，以 8 座塔架、每座 2 台液壓千斤頂提升~The Terminal 5 roof was built in 6 sections of about 2,200 t each, lifted by 8 towers with 2 hydraulic jacks each
第五航廈最後一段屋蓋於 2005 年 3 月提升就位~The final Terminal 5 roof section was lifted into position in March 2005
濱海灣金沙最大一次提升約 1,270 t，速度約 14 m/h，耗時超過 16 小時~The largest Marina Bay Sands lift was about 1,270 t at about 14 m/h over more than 16 hours
Pantadome 構法 1984 年首次用於神戶世界紀念館，1995 年用於大阪 Namihaya Dome~The Pantadome method was first used at Kobe's World Memorial Hall in 1984 and at Osaka's Namihaya Dome in 1995
常用 15.7 mm 預力鋼絞線斷面積約 150 mm²，1,860 MPa 級破斷力約 279 kN~A common 15.7 mm prestressing strand has about 150 mm² of area and a breaking load of about 279 kN in the 1,860 MPa grade
